coverageKind: Complete uninterrupted partitioned regression on one frozen source snapshot
qualification: The ordinary suite and two complementary precon shards all completed with actual process exit 0 and successful native Vitest reports. The 54 focused precon cases repeated by both shards count once. Earlier attempts interrupted to integrate verified rules corrections, and an ordinary-suite attempt interrupted by an execution-environment restart, contribute no cases to this result. Completed matrix shards survived that restart and retain their original exit-0 receipts.
